coverage_note: Family covers all A1/A2/A3_fm candidate runs available in data/predictions/v2 for the listed regions: A1 oversampling (2 seeds), A2 history noise (2 seeds), A3 FM (2 generator seeds x ratios 0.1/0.25/0.5), each paired against A0 of the SAME forecaster (2 seeds). That is 16 candidates x 2 baselines x 2 architectures x 5 regions = 320 tests. It does NOT enumerate the full historical search space: tail-aware A3 predictions are absent, and discarded ratios, generator hyperparameters and model-selection choices are not recorded as predictions. Bonferroni over 320 is therefore anti-conservative for the true search.
